title: Penguin reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#3b4a7a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#d9e6f2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='18' fill='#3b4a7a'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#e8f0f8'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#202a4a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#202a4a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='46,42 54,42 50,48' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- left flipper holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='60' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#4a5c94' transform='rotate(-25 26 60)'/>
  <!-- right flipper holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='60' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#4a5c94' transform='rotate(25 74 60)'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M30 52 L50 56 L50 78 L30 74 Z' fill='#f7f3e8'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M70 52 L50 56 L50 78 L70 74 Z' fill='#efe9d8'/>
  <!-- book cover edges -->
  <path d='M28 51 L50 55 L50 79 L28 75 Z' fill='#2a9d8f' opacity='0.25'/>
  <path d='M72 51 L50 55 L50 79 L72 75 Z' fill='#2a9d8f' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- spine -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='55' width='3' height='23' fill='#2a9d8f'/>
  <!-- text lines on left page -->
  <line x1='34' y1='58' x2='46' y2='60' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='63' x2='46' y2='65' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='68' x2='46' y2='70' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- text lines on right page -->
  <line x1='54' y1='60' x2='66' y2='58' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='65' x2='66' y2='63' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='70' x2='66' y2='68' stroke='#7a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='93' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- little highlight on head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='26' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#6b7fb8' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
